content: I am not going to pay the full deposit myself and chase people again.
I need a commitment from Dev and Nina before I pay my share.
I'm committed to the trip but financially unable to pay the deposit now due to the clutch repair and my promise to my wife.
I plan to pay the deposit after I get paid on the 28th, if that's still possible.
I know I need to decide about the trip and the deposit, but I'm avoiding it because of my mum's situation.
I am still holding the week until end of Wednesday 16th September. If no deposit arrives by then, I will release the week to the couple from Leeds.
I have done what I can for now. I will check for replies later today.
I'm aware I'm putting this off, but I need more clarity on my mum's situation before I can reply.
I feel guilty for delaying but Mum's recovery is my priority. I'll have to decide by Wednesday at the latest.
I'm starting to get anxious that they might not be interested, but I'll give them one more chance before I decide to cancel.
I'm now seriously considering that this trip might fall through if they don't respond today.
I'm still waiting for Dev and Nina to reply to my text. I'll check my phone around 9pm.
If no replies by now, I'm ready to let the cottage go and will message Marian to cancel.
I now believe Dev and Nina have lost interest or are avoiding me, so the trip is not going ahead.
The trip is definitely off. I have moved on.
I now realise I can't just wait and hope; I need to communicate my situation clearly or I'll lose the spot.
I have released the hold; the group missed the deposit deadline.
The voicemail confirms the group is not taking the cottage, so the hold is definitely ended.
The October half-term week is now definitely available, and I have no further obligations to Ruth's group.
I've finally acted on my intention to reply to Ruth.
Dev's text confirms he can't pay upfront, which would have required me to cover him again. I'm relieved I cancelled when I did.
